notes.summary: Economy gives 1–2 questions. Expect basic terms (GDP, inflation, deficits), RBI and its tools, banking milestones, Five-Year Plans and NITI Aayog, and GST. Questions test definitions and 'who publishes / when founded'.

concepts.title: Basic concepts
concepts.body:
• GDP: value of final goods and services produced within a country in a year. GNP = GDP + net income from abroad.
  • Sectors: primary (agriculture, mining), secondary (manufacturing, construction), tertiary (services). Services have the largest share of India's GDP.
  • Inflation: general rise in prices. CPI is compiled by the National Statistics Office (NSO), MoSPI. WPI is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce & Industry). RBI uses CPI inflation for its target.
  • Fiscal deficit = Total expenditure − Total receipts (excluding borrowings).

concepts.title: RBI and monetary tools
concepts.body:
• RBI was set up on 1 April 1935 (RBI Act 1934, on the Hilton Young Commission's advice) and nationalised in 1949. HQ: Mumbai.
  • First Indian Governor: C.D. Deshmukh.
  • The Monetary Policy Committee has 6 members and is chaired by the RBI Governor.
ToolMeaning
Repo rateRate at which RBI lends short-term to banks
Reverse repoRate at which RBI borrows from banks
CRRShare of deposits banks must keep with RBI as cash
SLRShare of deposits banks keep themselves in liquid assets (cash, gold, government securities)
To control inflation RBI raises these rates; to boost growth it lowers them.

concepts.title: Budget and GST
concepts.body:
• The Union Budget is the Annual Financial Statement under Article 112.
  • The Economic Survey is prepared by the Ministry of Finance and presented before the Budget.
  • GST came into force on 1 July 2017 through the 101st Amendment. The GST Council (Article 279A) is chaired by the Union Finance Minister.
  • Revolutions: Green — food grains (M.S. Swaminathan in India); White — milk (Verghese Kurien, Operation Flood).

varieties.name: Plans, budget and GST
varieties.how: Pair each plan or reform with its year and key feature.

steps: Planning Commission (1950) was replaced on 1 January 2015

tips: CPI = consumers = NSO; WPI = wholesale = Commerce Ministry (DPIIT).
GST: 101st Amendment, 1 July 2017, Article 279A for the Council.
traps: CRR is kept with RBI; SLR is kept by the bank itself.
RBI was founded in 1935 but nationalised only in 1949.
Fiscal deficit excludes borrowings from receipts — borrowings are what fill the gap.

questions.q: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.solution:
RBI's central office is in Mumbai. It was first in Kolkata (Calcutta) and moved to Mumbai in 1937.
Memory hook: Mumbai = India's money capital = RBI home.

questions.q: GST was introduced in India on:
questions.solution:
GST came into force on 1 July 2017 after the 101st Constitutional Amendment (2016).
Memory hook: 'One nation, one tax' started mid-year: 1-7-17.

questions.q: Which sector includes agriculture and mining?
questions.solution:
The primary sector uses natural resources directly: agriculture, fishing, forestry and mining.
Memory hook: Primary = straight from nature.

questions.q: The portion of deposits that banks must keep with the RBI in the form of cash is called:
questions.solution:
Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) is kept as cash with RBI. SLR is held by the bank itself in liquid assets such as gold and government securities.
Memory hook: CRR = Cash with the Central bank.

questions.q: The Wholesale Price Index (WPI) in India is released by:
options: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
questions.solution:
WPI is released by the Office of the Economic Adviser, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Ministry of Commerce & Industry). CPI is released by NSO.
Memory hook: Wholesale = trade = Commerce Ministry.

questions.q: The Second Five-Year Plan (1956–61) was based on the model of:
questions.solution:
The Second Plan stressed heavy industry and was based on the P.C. Mahalanobis model. The First Plan used the Harrod–Domar model.
Memory hook: Second plan = 'Steel' = Mahalanobis.

questions.q: How many commercial banks were nationalised in India in July 1969?
questions.solution:
In July 1969, 14 major commercial banks were nationalised. Six more were nationalised in 1980, making 20.
Memory hook: 1969 → 14; 1980 → 6; total 20.

questions.q: Fiscal deficit is best defined as:
options: Total expenditure − Total receipts excluding borrowings
questions.solution:
Fiscal deficit = Total expenditure − Total receipts excluding borrowings. It shows how much the government must borrow. Option 3 is revenue deficit; option 4 is primary deficit.
Memory hook: Fiscal deficit = the borrowing need.
